title: Indian Crispy Tofu Noodles
description: This Indian-inspired dish combines crispy tofu with a delicious noodle stir-fry, offering a flavorful and nutritious meal option.

ingredients.name: tofu
ingredients.notes: Extra-firm, drained and cut into bite-sized pieces

ingredients.name: vietnamese
ingredients.notes: Mixed vegetables, such as cabbage, carrots, and bean sprouts

instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the tofu and cook until golden brown and crispy, about 5-7 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil. Add the mixed vegetables and cook until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the noodles to the skillet and cook until heated through, about 2 minutes.
In a small bowl, mix together the curry powder, garam masala, salt, and pepper. Add this spice mixture to the noodles and stir to combine.
Return the cooked tofu to the skillet and toss to combine with the noodles and vegetables.
Serve hot, garnished with lemon wedges if desired.
